edits.new: For a general child, ask what information, if any, admitted by the child escapes every parent alternative or permitted connection. When an applicable parent requirement is absent from the child's explicit wording, focus the question on one such requirement. Ask whether a case can satisfy the child's entire meaning while violating that requirement. Preserve the child's defining kind or activity and every restriction. Keep other shared conditions satisfied so they cannot explain the failure. Name the requirement being investigated, leaving concrete case construction to the matching answer; do not presume that a counterexample exists.
edits.old: For a general child, ask what information, if any, admitted by the child can violate a specified applicable parent requirement while escaping every parent alternative or permitted connection. Name the requirement being investigated, leaving concrete case construction to the matching answer; do not presume that a counterexample exists.

edits.new: Investigate the same requirement named in that question in its matching answer.
edits.old: Investigate that question in its matching answer.
